$ tpatch apply --help
exit 0
Execute a feature's apply recipe or record an apply session.

Use 'tpatch feature unapply <slug>' to remove a feature's patch from the working tree.

Usage:
  tpatch apply <slug> [flags]

Flags:
      --dry-run                    Preview recipe execution without modifying files
  -h, --help                       help for apply
      --mode string                Apply mode: auto (default, runs prepare→execute→done), prepare, started, execute, done (default "auto")
      --note string                Operator notes about the apply session
      --validation-note string     Details about validation
      --validation-status string   Validation outcome: passed, failed, needs_review

Global Flags:
      --path string   Target repository path (default: current directory)
